capability: Keep DP metadata applicability and read-only canonical metadata-plan projection independent from Presentation and authoring availability
semanticOwner: Application owns terminal artifact classification, fixed exact-plan selection, and generic metadata-only resolution; Infrastructure only applies the returned terminal authority to accepted bytes and Presentation only projects the typed result
terminalContract: IsDpMetadataApplicable is decided by the terminal classification and projected without re-derivation; fixed Standard Merge and DP Replace consume their Application-returned exact plans; a typed CtrlRAM reference with an exact reportless plan is terminal, while an uncompiled reference or a reportful exact plan may use exactly one IC/count/capacity-bound DP metadata-only query for read-only DPCMI display without changing the CtrlRAM report plan or granting authoring/execution authority; CtrlRAM replacement-region inputs and AB Merge are not applicable; legacy unbound inspection selects exactly one capacity-bound Standard or DP metadata-only query from explicit TP-path presence, and ambiguity fails closed

designReview.evidence: The original independent behavior review required Application terminal classification to win over duplicate UI inference. A fixed-head CtrlRAM/hidden-DP audit then found production full-base DPCMI projection incorrectly coupled to ResolveUniqueRoute's authoring gate and required a typed metadata-plan-only query that cannot confer execution authority; retained-DP policy tests were explicitly rejected as production evidence. Read-only exact-path traces subsequently proved that Infrastructure ignored Standard/DP/CtrlRAM inspection-batch capabilities and re-resolved by IC/workflow. Full-verifier and UI evidence then exposed that treating every CtrlRAM exact omission as terminal removed DP/Jira while the initial IC-count suggestion was still pending. The corrected design keeps Infrastructure query-free, preserves fixed Standard/DP plan reuse and exact reportless CtrlRAM absence, and lets Application issue one bounded DP metadata-only query for an uncompiled or reportful CtrlRAM reference while AB facts remain bank-specific.
